title: Order status table shows stale statuses
issue: Support sees orders marked 'paid' or 'created' that were actually shipped or cancelled. `raw_order_events` is an event log; `order_status` must hold exactly one row per order with the status of its most recent event. Event timestamps come from several services in different ISO-8601 styles (space or 'T' separator, optional 'Z' or UTC offset). Compare them as real instants and write `updated_at` in UTC as 'YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS'.
